channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Supreme Court stays defamation proceedings against Rahul Gandhi over ‘commander-in-thief’ remark against PM Modi
item.description: The Supreme Court stayed further trial-court proceedings in a Maharashtra defamation case against Rahul Gandhi over remarks about Prime Minister Narendra Modi. It issued notices to the state government and complainant MH Shrishrimal, seeking responses within four weeks.

item.title: From IIT Kanpur to Election Commission: Here's a look at CEC Gyanesh Kumar's journey as calls for his resignation grow
item.description: CEC Gyanesh Kumar faces calls for removal over alleged irregularities in electoral roll revisions. A former Kerala-cadre IAS officer, he became CEC in February 2025 after serving in key government roles, including handling Kashmir affairs and matters related to the Ayodhya verdict.

item.title: India’s top cities among the worst in the world in quality of life: Check how Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai and others fare
item.description: All 10 of India’s highest-ranked cities placed within the top 500 of Oxford Economics’ 2026 Global Cities Index.&nbsp;

item.title: US 2028 presidential race frontrunners: Will it be Kamala Harris vs Trump's VP JD Vance? What poll reveals
item.description: The battle of VPs: Former Vice President Kamala Harris and current Vice President JD Vance remain the two frontrunners in their parties' (Democrat and Republican) 2028 presidential primaries, the new poll revealed.

item.title: CJP protest: ‘Cockroaches sneaked into Jantar Mantar’ — Dipke says Ranka, Das, Ajinkya, others detained, shares video
item.description: Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shares a video on X that showed police catching hold of Ashutosh Ranka, who had a national flag in his hand. Chants of “Bharat Mata ki Jai” and other slogans were also heard.

item.title: CJP Protest: Delhi Police seeks extension of CAPF deployment till Oct 20. Here's why
item.description: Delhi CJP Protest: Police sought the CAPF extension, citing the possibility of protests by the Cockroach Janta Party and other organisations, sources said on Tuesday.

item.title: Independent audit of voter deletions, suspension of SIR among key prayers in SC plea by Rahul, INDIA bloc leaders
item.description: The plea has sought the constitution of an independent committee headed by a retired apex court judge, and assisted by technical experts and other citizens of eminence, to conduct within a fixed time an independent audit of deletions and modifications made during the SIR.

item.title: ‘ ₹220 shortfall in court fee, missing pages’: Supreme Court registry cites 10 defects in Rahul Gandhi's plea
item.description: Supreme Court registry flagged more than 10 defects in Rahul Gandhi's petition challenging alleged voter deletions and irregularities in the electoral-roll revision. The petition seeks an independent audit, safeguards against voter removal without notice, and suspension of the ongoing revision.

item.title: Delhi’s new protest site comes at a cost: Ramlila Maidan booking tops ₹1.2 lakh, no dates till December, says report
item.description: The ground is booked through the Municipal Corporation of Delhi's horticulture department, which grants the permission. A no-objection certificate from Delhi Police is mandatory before the civic body clears an application.

item.title: Who is Kimberly Guilfoyle? US ambassador to Greece who could be removed by Trump amid misconduct reports
item.description: Trump is considering removing US ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle amid misconduct allegations, including seeking money for access to administration figures. The former Fox News host’s lawyers deny wrongdoing, saying she was collecting payment for work already done.

item.title: Weather Update, Northeast Monsoon onset: IMD predicts heavy rain in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka this week
item.description: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said commencement of northeast monsoon could bring wet spells over the south peninsula during the next two to three days.

item.title: Fuel prices today: Check petrol, diesel and CNG rates on 13 October in different cities across India
item.description: Petrol and diesel rates were unchanged in several cities on 13 October, while others saw increases or reductions. Bengaluru had the largest cuts and Patna the biggest rises for both fuels.&nbsp;

item.title: Delhi Protests: Traffic curbs and routes to avoid commuters should know before heading out today
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police warned of possible disruptions on Tuesday as protests continue, with dynamic diversions expected at major junctions and roads. Motorists are urged to avoid non-essential travel through affected areas. Air and rail services are not expected to face significant disruption.

item.title: ‘It's not really a deal for me; it's a deal for the rest of the world', says Trump as he defends Russian diesel supplies
item.description: Donald Trump defended the diesel deal with Russia, saying it would benefit American farmers and ease global fuel pressures. He claimed that Vladimir Putin was more willing than Volodymyr Zelenskyy to reach a peace agreement, while the Ukrainian leader warned the deal would help fund Moscow’s war.

item.title: Elon Musk ‘largest single donor’ with $276 million boost to Republicans in US midterms: Who gets what?
item.description: SpaceX and Tesla boss Elon Musk is likely the largest single donor for the November 3 elections. He spent a total of $366 million this election cycle. The $276 million has been contributed since July.

item.title: Earthquake Today: Magnitude 6 tremor jolts Panama days after massive 7.7 quake
item.description: An earthquake of magnitude 6 struck Panama on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said.

item.title: Centre kicks off FY28 budget planning, seeks new spending proposals
item.description: The Department of Expenditure has activated budget-code system, asking ministries to flag new schemes early as the government prepares to balance spending priorities with fiscal consolidation.

item.title: Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs rushed out of prison for emergency medical treatment after reportedly suffering head injury
item.description: Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs was reportedly taken from a New Jersey federal prison to hospital after suffering a head injury. The injury was described as non-life-threatening, while his representative said they were working to confirm the circumstances.

item.title: Selma Blair arrested after alleged mid-air altercation leaves two flight attendants injured on New York-bound flight
item.description: Actor Selma Blair was arrested at New York’s JFK Airport after an alleged altercation aboard a Delta flight from Los Angeles left two flight attendants injured. Her representative said a medical emergency led to the incident. The FBI is investigating.

item.title: Google defends $15 billion Vizag AI hub as water fears, land disputes and protests put project under scrutiny
item.description: Google says its $15 billion Visakhapatnam AI hub will use air cooling to limit water consumption, but protests over land acquisition, environmental risks and employment persist. The facility is expected to become operational in 2028.

item.title: Poonch LoC: Four killed in IED blast in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir, vigilance heightened
item.description: At least four people from Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir were killed in an IED blast near the Line of Control in Poonch on Monday. The incident prompted heightened security.&nbsp;

item.title: Pope Leo XIV’s planned lung surgery: What a lung nodule means, why it needs removal and what comes next
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is due to undergo surgery at Rome’s Gemelli Hospital to remove a small, localised lung nodule detected during recent medical examinations. The Vatican expects about a week of recovery, but has not disclosed whether the growth is cancerous.

item.title: Iran's Mohsen Rezaei speaks to Ajit Doval amid Gulf shipping attacks, Strait of Hormuz tensions
item.description: In a post on X, the Iranian Embassy in India informed of the discussions between the two officials, noting that the talks focused on matters ranging from regional affairs to bilateral ties between India and Iran.

item.title: Indian Army launches ‘Bharat Rice’ to improve ration quality for troops in remote areas
item.description: According to the Defence Ministry, the rice will undergo mandatory quality-control checks to ensure it is free from foreign matter and impurities, with minimal broken, damaged and discoloured grains.

item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts Riyadh airport until October 17 after attacks: Why Houthi missiles are getting through
item.description: Saudi Arabia has extended Riyadh airport’s closure until Oct 17 after Houthi attacks. The strikes have raised questions about the kingdom’s air defences, as drones and missiles reportedly penetrated its systems, exposing challenges in intercepting mixed attacks and protecting critical infra.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe denies transfer reports, says he continues as Maharashtra FDA chief despite MPSC probe committee post
item.description: Maharashtra FDA chief Tukaram Mundhe denied reports that he had been transferred, saying he remains commissioner and will continue efforts against unsafe food and substandard drugs.

item.title: Trump’s Russia diesel deal sparks bipartisan backlash: Why the move is under fire
item.description: Trump’s move to ease sanctions on Russian diesel imports to curb soaring US fuel prices has triggered bipartisan backlash, raising questions over Washington’s efforts to pressure Moscow over the Ukraine war and whether the deal will offer meaningful relief to American consumers.

item.title: FM invites Worldsteel to open India office, says carbon tariffs won’t solve steel surplus
item.description: Nirmala Sitharaman urged the World Steel Association to establish a local base amid rising domestic demand, warning that unilateral tools like the EU's CBAM only redirect excess global capacity without fixing overproduction.

item.title: R V Arlekar moves to Tamil Nadu as Centre appoints new governors for 6 states
item.description: Om Prakash Mathur, Governor of Sikkim, will be the new Governor of Keralam in place of Arlekar, a communique issued by the Rashtrapati Bhavan said.

item.title: Sitharaman pitches India investment opportunities to global investors in Singapore
item.description: Talks spanned infrastructure, semiconductors and digital finance as India seeks to deepen investment ties with Singapore despite a decline in exports.

item.title: GST compliance may tighten for businesses paying for overseas software, cloud and consulting services
item.description: The GST Council has proposed expanding e-invoicing to imported services and purchases from unregistered suppliers under the reverse charge mechanism for businesses with an annual turnover of ₹5 crore or more. A return correction mechanism is also proposed from April 2027.

item.title: Vijay urges PM Modi to fast-track Bengaluru-Hosur metro link, seeks funds for Tamil Nadu projects
item.description: Tamil Nadu CM C Joseph Vijay urged PM Narendra Modi to fast-track the Bengaluru-Hosur metro link and approve Chennai Metro Phase III.&nbsp;

item.title: Why Arab parties could hold the key to government formation in Israel’s next election
item.description: Israel election polls suggest neither Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc nor the Jewish opposition may secure a parliamentary majority. With Arab parties projected to win 8-12 seats, their support could prove crucial to government formation. Here’s what the seat projections reveal.

item.title: Former financial services secretary Nagaraju named IL&FS CMD for two years
item.description: Former financial services secretary M. Nagaraju has been appointed chairman and managing director of IL&amp;FS for two years. He takes charge as the group nears the final stages of resolving debt and assets following its 2018 crisis.

item.title: Indian Railways eyes 24-coach Vande Bharat Sleeper with upgraded features, pantry car, advanced toilets and more
item.description: Each coach will have individual reading lights, charging points and refreshment tables. The interiors will also feature glass fibre-reinforced plastic (GFRP) panels.
